name: Escapement
hint: The lift wants three riders. The spring wants a friend upstairs.
why4: The lift only rises with three aboard and the lid in its shaft only opens while a fourth stands on the plate; the fourth then needs someone upstairs to uncap the spring.
solution: P4 stands on the plate at x=18: lid A in the lift shaft opens.
P1, P2, P3 step onto the lift (x=5-8); with 3/3 aboard it rises 9 tiles to the top floor (4.5 s). They step right onto the top floor (x>=9).
P1 touches the key at x=12. P2 walks to the button at x=24 and touches it: the cap gate E on the floor spring at x=24 opens for 6 s.

P4 leaves the plate (the lid closes, nobody needs it now), walks 6 tiles to x=24 and hops onto the spring (about 1.5 s): launched to 5.5, P4 steers right and lands on the mid ledge (x=26-31, height 5).
P4 hops onto the mid-ledge spring at x=29: launched 5.5 above the mid ledge, P4 steers left and lands on the top floor (its right end is x=26).
P1 opens the door at x=18; all press Down.
Recovery: anyone who drops back to the bottom uses the same spring route while a friend upstairs presses the button.
